column1: Sorting Things Out|1999|10|0||8.5,8.5,8.5,8,8,9,8.5,9,7,8|Geoffrey C. Bowker and Susan Leigh Star|Explanation of classification as infrastructure, coordination and institutional choice, not a cataloging manual. https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262024617/sorting-things-out/ verifies authors and original 1999; https://catalog.freelibrary.org/Record/1998115 supplies contents. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: coding, organizational memory and boundary cases add distinct mechanisms. T11 applies because disease, nursing and racial classification dominate the empirical case material even though the framework transfers to computing; T12=0 because information infrastructure is the organizing topic, power an application. Broad cross-period account H13=0. References 335–365 of 377 numbered pages documented by https://countycat.mcfls.org/Record/.b27101174 .

MP3, The Meaning of a Format|2012|0|0|2011|8.5,8.5,8,8.5,8,8.5,9,9,7.5,8|Jonathan Sterne|History of perceptual compression linking psychoacoustics, telecommunications research, standards, storage costs and circulation. https://www.dukeupress.edu/mp3 verifies 2012 and scope; https://www.jstor.org/stable/j.ctv1131dh6 gives extended description. Central technology and engineering choices qualify for T12=0 despite media applications; international development T11=0. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: constraints across research, coding and distribution add mechanisms, cultural interpretation may be less direct. Approximate historical endpoint 2011. No codec implementation training; no claim that MP3 remains the dominant format in 2026.

Into the Cool|2005|0|0||6.5,8,6.5,7,7.5,8,7.5,8,7.5,7|Eric D. Schneider and Dorion Sagan|General synthesis of energy flow and self-organization across physical and living systems. https://press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/book/chicago/I/bo3533936.html supplies purpose and staged structure; https://opac.ramapo.edu/cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl?biblionumber=184494 confirms original 2005 rather than current paperback 2006. The second law alone does not prove every proposed ecological or economic pattern; broad analogical reach lowers E, without an established serious central veto. D=7.5 low confidence from description and attributed reviews: different physical/biological cases add constraints, sweeping extensions can be lower-yield. Energy/complexity is central; ecology, politics and health are application domains rather than predominant subjects, T11/T12=0. No historical-period deduction or thermodynamics curriculum purpose.

Order Out of Chaos|1979|0|10||7,8,7,7.5,7.5,8.5,8,9,7.5,7|Ilya Prigogine and Isabelle Stengers|Popular historical/philosophical account of nonequilibrium processes and time, distinct from a specialist thermodynamics textbook. https://www.cca.qc.ca/en/search/details/library/publication/10146336 identifies English edition as based on La nouvelle alliance; https://doi.org/10.1007/s40656-023-00576-5 establishes French original 1979 and relationship to Monod. Scientific insights into dissipative structures do not establish every broader claim about determinism or cultural change; E reduced, no consensus inferred from a Nobel Prize. D=7.5 low-confidence contents and scholarly historical analysis estimate: physical examples and conceptual history add learning, philosophical extrapolation has variable yield. T12 philosophy, T11=0; broad cross-period argument H13=0.

The Nature of Value|2014|0|10||7,8.5,8,7.5,7.5,8,8,7.5,7.5,7|Nick Gogerty|Conceptual explanation of innovation, competitive niches, capabilities and value allocation using evolutionary analogies. https://cup.columbia.edu/book/the-nature-of-value/9780231162449/ supplies author, 2014 and contents. Despite investment subtitle, primary value is an explanatory framework rather than technical security-analysis procedures; moderate eligibility confidence. Biological analogy is not independent empirical validation of financial claims. D=7.5 low-confidence contents/description estimate: capability, cluster and moat levels add distinctions; framework terminology can have lower yield. Finance/allocation T12, ecology auxiliary T11=0, H13=0. No get-rich-quick promise established.

The Meaning of Everything|2003|0|0|1928|8,7,6.5,6.5,7,9,6.5,8,8.5,8|Simon Winchester|History of producing the Oxford English Dictionary through volunteer coordination, editing and information organization. https://search.worldcat.org/title/52830480 confirms original 2003; publisher jacket reproduced at https://www.abaa.org/book/659021323 describes concrete workflow and omissions. Eligible history of knowledge production, not a dictionary or writing manual. D=7 low-confidence description estimate: scale and coordination cases add learning, colorful personalities are less transferable. British setting does not make national history the central subject, T11=0; information production rather than media politics, T12=0. Central first-edition completion endpoint 1928, moderate confidence.

Stylized: A Slightly Obsessive History of Strunk & White|2009|10|10||7,5.5,4.5,4.5,6,8,3.5,7.5,8,8|Mark Garvey|Archival literary history of The Elements of Style and its reception, not the manual itself. Author's introduction https://markgarvey.com/samples/sample_downloads/Stylized_Introduction.pdf and https://search.worldcat.org/title/310397075 establish 2009 and celebratory purpose. Retain modest payload about editing, institutional transmission and standards; admiration alone is not ideological capture. D=6 low confidence from introduction/description: letters add history, testimonials and literary personalities have limited strategic yield. T11 predominantly US literary institutions and T12 publishing/media history; multi-period reception H13=0. Do not infer that every rule in the celebrated manual is linguistically correct.

The Pleasures of Reading in an Age of Distraction|2011|0|10||7.5,5,6,5,6.5,8,3.5,8,8.5,8|Alan Jacobs|Reflective argument for reading by interest, attention and rereading, not a technical study-skills curriculum. https://obnb.uk/p15785266-the-pleasures-of-reading-in-an-age-of-distraction establishes 2011; https://books.google.com/books?id=k2v9wAEACAAJ describes varied reading practices. Some transferable heuristics remain despite low domain fit and personal-advice orientation. D=6.5 low-confidence description estimate: distinctions about rereading and attention add learning, reassurance may be lower-yield. T12 pragmatic philosophy of reading; US opening context is not the whole narrative/influence T11=0; H13=0. Religious books as examples do not make the work devotional.

How to Talk About Books You Haven't Read|2007|0|10||6.5,5.5,6,5.5,6.5,8,3.5,8,8,7|Pierre Bayard|Tongue-in-cheek literary essay about memory, partial reading and cultural conversation, not fiction or a specialist procedural course. https://search.worldcat.org/title/173499542 and https://www.richlandlibrary.com/catalog/detail/284903 establish English 2007 and chapter distinctions. Useful insight into degrees of acquaintance with texts does not justify factual claims about uninspected books; E reduced for provocative generalizations. D=6.5 low-confidence contents/description estimate: distinct forms of non-reading add concepts, literary examples can repeat the social thesis. T12 philosophy/literary culture, T11/H13=0. No V1 solely because the title is deliberately provocative.
